text_block_list.text:
One day, I spotted Mihono Bourbon out on the academy track.
She seemed to be pushing herself hard with quite an intense routine, but—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: W-What's wrong? Bourbon-san?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: (...*grumble*...)

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Internal energy... depleted.
All systems down confirmed...
Error, error, error...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"Come on, eat, eat!
There are plenty of seconds!"

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Thank you...
Time to eat...!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Haha, you sure eat with gusto.
It really makes cooking it feel worth it.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Still, you must have been pushing yourself so hard... to the point you couldn't even move.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"...My aptitude is originally for sprints.
To take on long distances, rigorous
training is absolutely necessary."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"However—lately, I've often been
running out of energy during training—
even though I've been trying to be careful."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"...Anyway, thank you very much.
I should be getting back to training soon."

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
B-But are you really okay?
What if you collapse again...?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...I am well aware that to achieve my dream,
a half-baked training program simply will not do.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: T-That's... Rice understands that too, but...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
............ U-Um! Is there any way
I could support you with my cooking!?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Like meals that relieve fatigue, are easy to digest,
and turn into energy right away...
I just wanted to help out, even if it's only a little.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I've always had an interest in cooking.
I'd be glad if you let me make various things for you, if it's alright... W-What do you think?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: "Flower-san. But... we couldn't possibly ask you to go that far for us..."

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
P-Please let Rice help too...!
Because... I always see Bourbon-san
working so hard...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
If our vegetables can help
even just a little bit...!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"...And that's what my crew is saying, too.
Whaddya say? It'd be great
learning experience for us, too!"

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you very much.
Well then... if you please, everyone.

And so, it was decided that I would
support Mihono Bourbon through "nutrition."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Hah! Hah!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Weight training and the high-intensity circuit routine... both are complete.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Great work, Miss Bourbon! Now then, the meal Flower-san and I made together...!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Since we just finished weight training...!
Here's a pot-au-feu packed with plant-based protein and tons of beans!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Status... 『Hungry』.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
You must be exhausted...!
Here, have some fatigue-recovering garlic-loaded
vegetable broth ramen!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Huff... huff...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Miss Bourbon looks like she's in great shape lately!
I wonder if the meals are having an effect?
I sure hope so...!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
...Huh? Bourbon...
stopped moving?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...Energy... depleted...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I-Is it that bad!?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... When it comes to prolonged exercise,
running completely out of energy is inevitable, huh...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: The long-distance wall... is thicker than I ever imagined.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Maybe I should learn to make
a special stamina dish to build endurance...?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
(Stamina... energy...
To run long distances, what's truly important when it comes to "food"...?)

A few days later—I spotted Nishino Flower and Rice Shower
looking for materials in the library.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Yes. I'm a bit stuck, so... I thought returning to the basics and studying again might give me fresh ideas.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Still, the collection here really is amazing...
Even under nutrition, it's divided into so many specific fields, it might be tough to find a good book—

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: "In that case! Would you mind trying out these materials!"

Beside Chairwoman Akikawa—
a massive pile of books and files
was stacked high!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"I heard that the two of you are working hard on developing new menu items...!
So the chairwoman and I went and found some recommended books for you!"

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Plus, data I gathered at the academy!
My personal memoranda!
Please make good use of it!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"Chairwoman, Rob Roy...
Th-Thank you so much!"

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Mm! While many students strive for proper nutritional management, those who thoroughly grasp the theory and put it into practice... are still a minority!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
If you achieve great results and inspire the students,
it will benefit the entire academy!
I have high hopes for you!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: ...! W-We'll do our best!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Mm! And one more thing!
Developing a new menu is splendid and all, but—

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Don't just focus on "what kind of food it is"—the answer might also be hidden in "how you eat it" and "when you eat it," you know?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: "Chairwoman...? Does that mean—"

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Why, you two will reach the answer in no time!
Now, give it your all!

"And some time later—
when Mihono Bourbon ran in a certain mock race."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...Heh!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
*pant, pant*... B-Bourbon-san,
when did you get like this...?! To not lose your pace until the very end, over such a long distance...!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
O-Oh yeah, I heard! Bourbon-san,
Flower-chan and the others made you
a super nutritious secret menu item, right?!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...Indeed. We received tremendous support
from Flower-san and the others this time.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
R-Really? What kind of secret menu!?
I want to know too!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"...To tell the truth... the menu itself
isn't anything out of the ordinary."

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Ehehe... Actually, that's true.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
...We all studied up again using the materials
Madam Chairwoman and the others gave us.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
—Um, for each meal: staple, main dish, side dish.
The nutrients to take from each are—

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Fatigue recovery effects... Vitamin C, citric acid.
Mainly green and yellow vegetables, citrus fruits—
Input complete.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Good morning. Went to bed as scheduled,
3 hours after dinner—8 hours of sleep, completed.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"However, because of this... I had to drop one routine.
I won't be able to do my evening run."

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm sorry. But...
I'm sure it'll be effective in the long run...!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I don't doubt you at all. Flower-san, Rice-san... I believe in both of you.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Miss Bourbon...!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Of course, I prepared nutritionally balanced menus for
every meal—but even more than that, I prioritized
lifestyle habits and meal timing.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"Still... I actually prepared a secret weapon
for the real deal!"

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
—A secret program...
"Glycogen loading," is it?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Huh? A... A legit secret weapon!?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: N-No! You see, glycogen loading is—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Not just for everyday training, but one could say it's a practical culinary application in preparation for the big event.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Carbohydrates are a crucial source of energy,
but... among them, glycogen is an especially
important type of carbohydrate.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: "However, the amount of glycogen the body can store is limited... If we aren't careful, it'll deplete in no time."

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: —And so, to ensure maximum glycogen is stored for the day of the race, I'll be structuring her daily meal plan.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: "That is what they call... glycogen loading!"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Mmmgh... C-Come to think of it, did my Trainer mention carbs before...?
I feel like I heard about it in class, too...!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
...I really need to study properly myself!
All right, I'm gonna do it~!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: "...Thank you so much for everything this time, everyone."

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
No, no! Thank *you*...!
Because of Bourbon-san, I was able to learn so much...!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: At first, all I could think about was putting together an amazing menu... but that wasn't all there was to it.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"Just like the Chairwoman said...
When and how you eat on a daily basis
really does change how you run."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...This time, I've gained a powerful weapon.
I intend to continue learning
about food on my own going forward.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Should fate allow it... I would like to show you
the fruits of our efforts on the turf.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah!
R-Rice and the others will keep studying too!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
"...Fufu. Splendid!
I knew you wouldn't let me down!"
